lead_html: Equinox is E natural minor with one note left out. Play each card's lit notes, then move to the next.
history_html: E Equinox is built on E natural minor with the fourth note, A, left out. That leaves six different notes (E, F#, G, B, C, D) and a quiet, open minor sound. Kirstein lists the nine fields as E3 G3 B3 C4 D4 E4 F#4 G4 B4, and says Sela makes it with nine fields while Schlagwerk makes its E Equinox with eight.
og_description: E Equinox 9 handpan chords: three chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
